meta_title: Nick Newbould Plumbing & Heating | Sunderland Plumber
meta_description: Nick Newbould Plumbing & Heating Ltd in Sunderland. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and heating installations. Fast response, local expertise. Call today.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am? We're here. Emergency calls answered any time, with most jobs completed same day.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Sunderland
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle every aspect of your home's plumbing and heating.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry common parts on the van and aim to resolve most issues on the first visit, 24 hours a day.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted with a 10-year parts guarantee and full system commissioning. We'll advise on efficiency ratings to cut your heating bills.

services.title: Central Heating Repairs
services.desc: Radiators not heating, pumps failing, or thermostats playing up? We diagnose the fault quickly and get your system running again.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New tap installations, shower repairs, and complete bathroom or kitchen plumbing — we work to Building Regulations and leave no mess.

services.title: Landlord Safety Certificates
services.desc: Annual gas safety checks and comprehensive plumbing inspections to keep your rental property compliant and insured.

services.title: Powerflush & System Descaling
services.desc: Restore heating efficiency and eliminate cold radiators with a professional powerflush. Improves boiler performance and extends system life.

about_pullquote: I started this to be the plumber I'd want to call in a crisis.
about_para_1: Nick Newbould Plumbing & Heating has been serving Sunderland households and businesses for nearly two decades. Founded on the principle that emergency plumbing shouldn't mean waiting days or paying eye-watering call-out fees, we've built a reputation for rapid response and straightforward pricing. We're Gas Safe Registered and fully insured.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we answer the phone, we show up on time, and we explain what's wrong before we charge. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a planned boiler upgrade, you get the same honest service. We've completed over 2,500 jobs across Sunderland and neighbouring areas, and that trust is something we work to earn every single day.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Woke up to a burst pipe in the kitchen at about 1am. Called Nick and he was round within the hour. Fixed it properly, no faffing about, and charged a fair price. That's how you want an emergency plumber to be. Will use him again and have already recommended him to neighbours.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: New boiler fitted last month. The lads were tidy, explained everything as they went, and it's made a real difference to our heating. No surprises on the bill either. Can't fault it.
reviews.author: Margaret P.

reviews.text: Had a complete nightmare with radiators not working and another plumber had quoted £800 to powerflush the lot. Nick came, diagnosed it properly, did the job for less, and now every radiator heats perfectly. Worth every penny. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James M.
